title: Staff Software Engineer, Operational Excellence
description: Change the way the world travels Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step. Team mission Incidents interrupt operations, drain team productivity, and erode user trust. As a member of the Operational Excellence team, you will help GetYourGuide notice problems sooner, fix them faster, and stop the same ones from coming back, so our travelers and suppliers see fewer disruptions and trust us more. As we push boldly into AI-powered experiences, we don’t ignore the risks that increased output velocity creates. Faster change means more places for silent failures to hide. You will help our engineering organisation move fast with confidence, with the safeguards (tests, safe rollouts, monitoring, clear ownership) that catch problems before customers do. Observability and cost efficiency are part of the same job: teams can’t fix or own what they can’t see. You will build the tooling, standards, and habits that make operational excellence a shared standard across all engineering teams, from blameless learning after every incident to alerts teams trust and cost visibility per team. Your mission You will act as an "engineer for the engineers" — partnering with other engineering teams to raise the bar on reliability, speed, and confidence in their systems. Incident management & reliability Drive down how often incidents happen, how long it takes us to notice them, and how long it takes to fix them, with a focus on catching problems with monitors instead of by chance Lead post-incident reviews, translate learnings into systemic improvements, and make sure follow-up actions actually get done Build tooling and runbooks that enable teams to detect, diagnose and resolve production issues faster Champion a culture of blameless incident handling and continuous improvement Observability & production confidence Advance our Datadog-based observability practice — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting Help teams set measurable reliability targets with actionable alerts that reach the right owner — not alert fatigue Enable production debugging capabilities so engineers can triage issues without needing a specialist Change confidence & release quality Reduce how often changes cause failures in production by helping teams find and close the biggest gaps in their automated testing Make testing and CI faster and more reliable for product teams, so engineers trust their tests instead of working around them Identify blast radius risks and architectural gaps in evolving systems, and drive mitigation Reduce the cost and risk of deployments through better tooling, feature flagging, and progressive rollout practices Platform enablement Design and maintain paved paths: well - documented golden paths for development, observability, testing, and incident response so engineering teams can do the right things by default Work hands-on with product teams using Java and React to help them improve system design, testability, and operational hygiene Draw on Kubernetes, AWS, and service mesh expertise to guide product teams on infrastructure best practices Make infrastructure cost visible to teams and help them find and act on efficiency opportunities Leverage AI tooling to accelerate incident response, improve developer workflows, and scale operational practices Your toolkit 8+ years of relevant industry experience Deep understanding of observability tooling — we use Datadog (metrics, APM, logs, dashboards) — and of what makes alerts and production debugging effective Track record of improving the reliability of production systems at scale Strong coding skills in Java; comfortable reading and contributing in Go across infrastructure contexts; enough frontend context to collaborate with React / Vue teams Working experience with Kubernetes and AWS, and familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio/Envoy) Solid understanding of distributed systems, networking, and container technology Hands-on experience with automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels, as well as CI/CD and build systems Hands-on, everyday use of AI in your engineering work You have led improvements that reached many teams at once, not just your own, with results you can point to: You have helped teams ship with more confidence and fewer production surprises You have embedded operational excellence practices into the culture of product engineering teams, not just platform teams You have helped teams cut or avoid cost through technical or operational improvements You have driven AI adoption beyond yourself: workflows you built are relied on by others and visibly changed how they work You communicate in clear, concise English: you listen to understand, adapt to your audience, and make sure people know what to do next You are a positive, proactive team player who is passionate about operational excellence and who helps others deliver How to apply Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below.
